# AnimationVAT engine tools (vendored)

Upstream MIT examples from **OpenVAT** by Luke Stilson, vendored so the Export tab
works offline. The engine runtime is third-party; the VAT bake itself is UniMate's.

- `unity/AnimationVAT_Unity.unitypackage` — Unity URP importer + shaders (v1.1.0)
- `unreal5/AnimationVAT_Unreal.zip` + extracted contents — Unreal Engine 5 tools
- `godot/VertexAnimationPBR-GLSL.gdshader` — Godot shader (OpenVAT text renamed to AnimationVAT)
- `LICENSE` — MIT license of the engine tools

Note: the Unity package's own setup window and the Unreal assets keep their
upstream internal names; only the file/folder names and the Godot shader text
were rebranded. Source: https://github.com/sharpen3d/openvat (engine tools, MIT).
